# ICanvas

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

A drawing surface that elements render onto. The PDF canvas writes content-stream operators; the SVG canvas records SVG elements. All coordinates and lengths are in points.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Properties

- [`graphicsStateDepth`](#graphicsstatedepth): How many graphics-state scopes are currently open (PDF `q` without its `Q`; SVG `<g>` without its `</g>`).
- [`height`](#height): Height of the drawing surface, in points.
- [`width`](#width): Width of the drawing surface, in points.

### `graphicsStateDepth`

```typescript
readonly graphicsStateDepth?: number | undefined
```

*optional, read-only*

How many graphics-state scopes are currently open (PDF `q` without its `Q`; SVG `<g>` without its `</g>`). A page break has to close these on the outgoing page and reopen them on the new one, the same way marked content is handled, because neither may cross a page boundary. Canvases that do not track graphics state may omit this.

### `height`

```typescript
readonly height: number
```

*read-only*

Height of the drawing surface, in points.

### `width`

```typescript
readonly width: number
```

*read-only*

Width of the drawing surface, in points.

## Methods

- [`addCircle`](#addcircle): Appends a closed circle to the current path.
- [`addEllipse`](#addellipse): Appends a closed axis-aligned ellipse to the current path, as four cubic Béziers (PDF has no arc operator).
- [`addRect`](#addrect): Appends a closed rectangle to the current path.
- [`beginArtifact`](#beginartifact): Starts a region of purely decorative content that is left out of the accessibility structure.
- [`beginContainerContent`](#begincontainercontent): Opens a structural grouping, such as a list, list item or table row, with the given role.
- [`beginCrispEdges`](#begincrispedges): Starts a region whose edges are drawn without anti-aliasing (SVG output only).
- [`beginMarkedContent`](#beginmarkedcontent): Opens a tagged region with the given structure role around the content drawn next.
- [`beginPath`](#beginpath): Starts a new, empty path.
- [`beginRoundedClip`](#beginroundedclip): Clips later drawing to a rectangle with rounded corners until `endClip` is called.
- [`clipToCurrentPath`](#cliptocurrentpath): Restricts later drawing to the inside of the current path, using the given fill rule (non-zero by default).
- [`closePath`](#closepath): Closes the current sub-path with a straight segment back to its start.
- [`cubicBezierTo`](#cubicbezierto): Adds a cubic Bézier curve from the current point to `(x, y)` using two control points.
- [`drawFormXObject`](#drawformxobject): Draws a reusable form (a previously registered group of drawing operations) at `(x, y)`.
- [`drawImage`](#drawimage): Draws a decoded image into the given rectangle.
- [`drawLine`](#drawline): Draws a straight line between two points.
- [`drawText`](#drawtext): Draws a single line of text with its origin at `(x, y)`, aligned relative to that point.
- [`drawTextJustified`](#drawtextjustified): Draws a single line of text stretched to fill `availableWidth` by widening the spaces between words.
- [`drawTextRotated`](#drawtextrotated): Draws a single line of text rotated by `angleDegrees` about `(x, y)`.
- [`endArtifact`](#endartifact): Ends the region started by `beginArtifact`.
- [`endClip`](#endclip): Removes the clip applied by `beginRoundedClip`.
- [`endCrispEdges`](#endcrispedges): Ends the region started by `beginCrispEdges`.
- [`endMarkedContent`](#endmarkedcontent): Closes the region opened by the most recent `beginMarkedContent` or `beginContainerContent`.
- [`fillCircle`](#fillcircle): Fills a circle centred on `(cx, cy)`.
- [`fillCurrentPath`](#fillcurrentpath): Fills the current path with a colour or gradient, using the given fill rule (non-zero by default).
- [`fillEllipse`](#fillellipse): Fills an axis-aligned ellipse centred on `(cx, cy)` with radii `rx` and `ry`.
- [`fillPath`](#fillpath): Fills the closed polygon described by `points`.
- [`fillRect`](#fillrect): Fills an axis-aligned rectangle with a solid colour.
- [`fillRoundedRect`](#fillroundedrect): Fills a rectangle with rounded corners of the given radius.
- [`isInsideArtifact`](#isinsideartifact): True while inside an /Artifact region (PDF canvas only).
- [`lineTo`](#lineto): Adds a straight segment from the current point to `(x, y)`.
- [`measureText`](#measuretext): Returns the width and height the text would occupy in the given font and size.
- [`moveTo`](#moveto): Starts a new sub-path at `(x, y)`.
- [`quadraticBezierTo`](#quadraticbezierto): Adds a quadratic Bézier curve from the current point to `(x, y)` using one control point.
- [`restoreState`](#restorestate): Pops the graphics state saved by the matching `saveState`.
- [`rotate`](#rotate): Rotates the coordinate system by the given angle, in degrees.
- [`saveState`](#savestate): Pushes the current graphics state (transform, clip and alpha) so that `restoreState` can return to it.
- [`scale`](#scale): Scales the coordinate system by `sx` horizontally and `sy` vertically.
- [`setGlobalAlpha`](#setglobalalpha): Sets the opacity (0 to 1) applied to everything drawn afterwards.
- [`setTextFeatures`](#settextfeatures): Select OpenType features for following text operations; omitted values use defaults.
- [`setTextSpacing`](#settextspacing): Sets the pending text-spacing state applied by subsequent `drawText` calls: `letterSpacing` points are added after every glyph and `wordSpacing` points after every space.
- [`strokeCurrentPath`](#strokecurrentpath): Strokes the current path with the given `StrokeStyle`.
- [`strokeRect`](#strokerect): Outlines an axis-aligned rectangle with a solid colour and stroke width.
- [`strokeRoundedRect`](#strokeroundedrect): Outlines a rectangle with rounded corners of the given radius.
- [`transform`](#transform): Applies an affine transform with the matrix `[a b c d e f]` to the coordinate system.
- [`translate`](#translate): Moves the origin of the coordinate system by `(tx, ty)`.

### `addCircle`

```typescript
addCircle(cx: number, cy: number, radius: number): void
```

Appends a closed circle to the current path. See `addEllipse`.

### `addEllipse`

```typescript
addEllipse(cx: number, cy: number, rx: number, ry: number): void
```

Appends a closed axis-aligned ellipse to the current path, as four cubic Béziers (PDF has no arc operator). Unlike `fillEllipse` this is a path primitive, so the result can be stroked with a full [`StrokeStyle`](stroke-style.md), filled with a gradient, or pushed as a clip.

### `addRect`

```typescript
addRect(x: number, y: number, width: number, height: number): void
```

Appends a closed rectangle to the current path.

### `beginArtifact`

```typescript
beginArtifact(): void
```

Starts a region of purely decorative content that is left out of the accessibility structure. Close it with `endArtifact`.

### `beginContainerContent`

```typescript
beginContainerContent(role: string): void
```

Opens a structural grouping, such as a list, list item or table row, with the given role. Unlike `beginMarkedContent` it carries no content of its own. Close it with `endMarkedContent`.

### `beginCrispEdges`

```typescript

```

Starts a region whose edges are drawn without anti-aliasing (SVG output only). Close it with `endCrispEdges`.

### `beginMarkedContent`

```typescript
beginMarkedContent(role: string): void
```

Opens a tagged region with the given structure role around the content drawn next. Close it with `endMarkedContent`. Does nothing when the document is not tagged.

### `setTextSpacing`

```typescript
setTextSpacing(letterSpacing: number, wordSpacing: number): void
```

Sets the pending text-spacing state applied by subsequent `drawText` calls: `letterSpacing` points are added after every glyph and `wordSpacing` points after every space. Callers set the state before drawing and reset it to `(0, 0)` afterwards. Both default to 0.
